title: Message
description: A single message element as returned in the 'messages' array of the channels__recv tool output (CONTRACTS.md §5.2). This is the wire representation of a stored message delivered to a receiving agent.

channel.description: Name of the channel this message was sent to.

sender.description: agent_id of the agent that sent the message.

body.description: Opaque message payload. SOX places no constraints on the body shape beyond it being a JSON object. See CONTRACTS.md §9 for recommended reserved field names (type, subject, context, question, answer, urgency).

correlation_id.description: Optional caller-supplied correlation token for request-reply matching or at-least-once deduplication. Null if the sender did not supply one.

sent_at.description: Unix epoch seconds (floating point) at which the message was accepted by the backing store.

message_id.description: Backing-store-assigned unique identifier for this message.

body.subject: Which database schema version should I target?
body.question: The task mentions schema v2 but the repo shows v3 in production. Which do I use?
